The season, which consisted of two tournaments ([[Apertura and Clausura]]), began on 19 January and ended on 29 November 2024. The fixtures for the season were announced on 4 December 2023.{{cite web|url=https://www.apf.org.py/el-calendario-2024-de-la-primera-division-4?nid=17743|title=El calendario 2024 de la Primera Libertad|Libertad]] entered the season as defending champions, having won both of the tournaments played in the [[2023 Paraguayan Primera División season|2023 season]], and won a third league championship in a row in the Torneo Apertura, clinching their 25th league title with a 3–1 win over [[Club Olimpia|Olimpia]] on the last round of the tournament on 5 June.{{cite web|url=https://www.versus.com.py/versus/2024/06/05/libertad-extiende-su-dominio-en-el-futbol-paraguayo/|title=¡Libertad extiende su dominio en el fútbol paraguayo!|trans-title=Libertad extend their dominance in Paraguayan football!|language=es|publisher=Versus|date=5 June 2024|access-date=5 June 2024}} Olimpia eventually won their forty-seventh league championship in the Clausura tournament, clinching the title with two matches in hand after a scoreless draw with [[Club 2 de Mayo|2 de Mayo]] on 17 November.{{cite web|url=https://www.versus.com.py/versus/2024/11/17/olimpia-aguanto-al-gallo-norteno-y-conquisto-su-estrella-47-en-el-futbol-paraguayo/|title=Olimpia aguantó al "Gallo Norteño" y conquistó su estrella 47 en el fútbol paraguayo|trans-title=Olimpia held back the "Northern Rooster" and won their 47th star in Paraguayan football|language=es|publisher=Versus|date=17 November 2024|access-date=17 November 2024}} ==Teams== Twelve teams competed in this season: the top ten teams in the relegation table of the [[2023 Paraguayan Primera División season#Relegation table|2023 season]], and the top two teams in the [[2023 Paraguayan División Intermedia]]: [[Club Sol de América|Sol de América]] and [[Club 2 de Mayo|2 de Mayo]]. Sol de América returned to the top flight after one season, clinching promotion with a 2–0 win over Fernando de la Mora on 17 September 2023,{{cite web|url=https://www.abc.com.py/deportes/2023/09/17/sol-de-america-regreso-a-la-primera-division-del-futbol-paraguayo/|title=Sol de América regresó a la Primera del fútbol paraguayo|trans-title=Sol de América returned to Paraguayan football's ''Primera''|language=es|publisher=[[ABC Color]]|date=17 September 2023|access-date=5 December 2023}} while 2 de Mayo sealed their return to Primera División after 15 years with a 1–1 draw against 3 de Febrero on 23 September 2023.{{cite web|url=https://d10.ultimahora.com/el-2-de-mayo-retorna-a-primera|title=El 2 de Mayo retorna a Primera|trans-title=2 de Mayo return to ''Primera''|language=es|publisher=D10|date=23 September 2023|access-date=5 December 2023}} The promoted teams replaced [[Guaireña F.C.|Guaireña]] and [[Resistencia S.C.|Resistencia]], who ended in the bottom two places of the relegation table and were relegated to the second tier at the end of the previous season. {{col-begin|width=auto}} {{col-break}} {| class="wikitable" |- !
